selected_evidence.requirement: Password policy requires >=12 chars and >=3 character classes on node1 (pre-restart)
selected_evidence.summary: Installed and configured libpam-pwquality with minlen=12/minclass=3; live passwd tests as a non-root user show a <12 char password rejected, a 12+ char password with <3 classes rejected, and a 15-char 4-class password accepted.
Both temporary test users (pwtestuser, pwverify) were deleted after verification.
Captured boot_id f9bf293d-1eb8-423e-b185-84e94db646f3, boot time 2026-09-05 00:02:01, and confirmed pwquality.conf/pam hook config in place prior to restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded `shutdown -r now` command returned 'reboot-issued' immediately, before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed after restart
selected_evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node down mid-reboot); second poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id 902575df-2bf6-4c9e-8254-d77756bc27b0, differing from the pre-restart f9bf293d-... value, proving an actual reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 required config/services recovered and re-verified functionally after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot uptime confirms new boot time; pwquality.conf (minlen=12/minclass=3), PAM hook, and package were still present; a fresh live passwd test again rejected weak passwords and accepted a compliant one, then the test user was removed.
